subscribe.title: Subscribe to Our Newsletter
subscribe.invalid: Please enter a valid email address.

pending.title: One more step
pending.body: A confirmation email is on its way. Click the link inside to finish subscribing. If it has not arrived in a few minutes, please check your spam or promotions folder.

alreadySubscribed.title: Already subscribed
alreadySubscribed.body: This address is already on our list, so there is nothing more to do. Thank you for being with us.

alreadyPending.title: Waiting for confirmation
alreadyPending.body: We already sent a confirmation email to this address. Please open it and click the link inside. If you cannot find it, check your spam or promotions folder.

rateLimited.title: Please slow down
rateLimited.body: Too many attempts in a short time. Please wait about a minute and try again.

forgotten.title: Cannot subscribe here
forgotten.body: This address was permanently removed from our list. For privacy reasons only you can bring it back, and not from this form. Please contact us and we will help you resubscribe.

restricted.title: Cannot subscribe this address
restricted.body: Our email provider has restricted this address, so it cannot be added automatically. Please contact us and we will sort it out with you.

failed.title: Something went wrong
failed.body: We could not complete your subscription just now. Please try again in a little while. If it keeps happening, please contact us.
